decisions.reason: Product B builds on the established offer and was retained in 2019, so its performance likely meets aspirations and slack is used to keep it with only a low drop risk.
As a single distant product with no evidence of market traction, D likely underperforms relative to aspirations, triggering problemistic search and leading management to drop it.
Although E has several models, it remains distant from the core and shows no clear success, so it falls short of aspirations and is dropped to free resources.
Similarly, F is distant and uncertain, underperforming relative to aspirations, so problemistic search leads to dropping it.
